title.narrative: UNIDO Country programming framework for inclusive and sustainable industrial development in the Philippines 2018- 2023

description.narrative: The government#s interest for UNIDO to have a Country Programme resulted from both missions of Philippine delegations to the Headquarters in Vienna, and, discussions of the UCR with government counterparts. In a way, these activities raised the knowledge of counterparts on the array of services being offered by UNIDO to member states and which can be availed of by the Philippines in support of national development plans and programs. On 21 February 2018, H.E. Ms. Maria Cleofe Natividad presented her credentials to UNIDO DG and requested the UNIDO Secretariat to develop a Country Programme for the Philippines. (attached Minutes) On 10 January 2018, the UCR in the Philippines Ms. Tonilyn Lim, paid a courtesy visit to DTI Secretary Lopez wherein the following areas of UNIDO interventions were requested (attached email, letter request to follow): On 17 August 2017 in a meeting with the GEF Focal Point (attached Minutes), UNIDO was requested to start the development of a sustainable cities project focusing on energy efficiency, as well as to develop a programmatic approach towards chemicals and waste management in the country, in preparation for GEF funding cycle 7.
